question: En cáncer de mama, ¿qué fármacos dirigidos al gen ERBB2 (HER2) aparecen en ensayos de fase 3 o de fase 2/3?

attempts.query:
SELECT DISTINCT d.pref_name
FROM linking.trial_drug td
JOIN aact.studies s ON s.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id AND md.label = 'Breast Neoplasms'
JOIN linking.drug_target dt ON dt.parent_chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
JOIN linking.target_gene tg ON tg.target_chembl_id = dt.target_chembl_id AND tg.gene_symbol = 'ERBB2'
JOIN linking.drug d ON d.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
ORDER BY 1
